brand_tagline: Walk Slowly. Be Present. Feel More.

tech_stack.styling: Tailwind CSS + Lucide Icons + Framer Motion
tech_stack.components: Shadcn/UI primitives in src/components/ui (customized for brand)

typography.display_font: Playfair Display, Cormorant Garamond, or serif font stack for headlines (font-serif)
typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans, DM Sans, or Inter (font-sans)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono or Courier Prime for booking codes & receipt reference IDs (font-mono)

heading_styles.h1_hero: font-serif text-4xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-normal leading-[1.05] tracking-tight text-[#1C1C1A] dark:text-[#F5F0E8]
heading_styles.h2_section: font-serif text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-normal leading-tight text-[#1C1C1A] dark:text-[#F5F0E8]
heading_styles.h3_card: font-serif text-xl sm:text-2xl font-medium text-[#1C1C1A] dark:text-[#F5F0E8]
heading_styles.overline_label: font-sans text-xs tracking-[0.25em] uppercase font-semibold text-[#2D4A3E] dark:text-[#A3B899]

typography.guidelines: DO NOT use Inter or generic sans for display headings. Main headlines MUST use serif. Use uppercase tracking for overlines and buttons.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16, py-24, py-32 (2x-3x generous spacing philosophy)

landing_page.hero: Misty forest photo background with semi-transparent overlay (bg-black/35), high contrast white/stone headline 'A Quieter Place For A Brighter You', CTAs 'Daftar Sekarang' and 'Jelajahi Pengalaman'.
landing_page.philosophy: 2-column layout with 'More Than A Hike' headline, 4 feature blocks (Mindful Experience, Small & Curated max 15, Beginner Friendly, Intentional Journey).
landing_page.quote_break: Full width 60vh image section with italic serif quote 'In silence, we begin to hear what matters.'
landing_page.upcoming_trips: Trip cards showing photo, badge (Easy/Moderate), price in IDR, date, location (e.g., Gunung Salak, Hutan Sentul, Taman Nasional Halimun), duration, available slots left (max 15).
landing_page.why_silence: Interactive or editorial breakdown with forest photography grid.
landing_page.shop_teaser: 4 apparel preview cards with quick add hover button and price.
landing_page.testimonials: Mindful community quote slider/tabs with photo thumbnails.
landing_page.journal: Featured story + 3 story cards with category badges and read time.
landing_page.special_programs: Dark contrast section (#1C1C1A background) for corporate & private silent hiking programs.
landing_page.faq_accordion: Clean border-b accordion items for quick questions.

trip_booking_flow.schedule_selection: Interactive date/schedule picker showing slots left (max 15 capacity per schedule). Clear warning badge when slots are low (<3 left).
trip_booking_flow.customization_step: Mandatory selection of T-shirt size (XS, S, M, L, XL, XXL) and Drink Bonus choice (Kopi Susu Forest or Cokelat Hangat).
trip_booking_flow.payment_step: Support for Manual Transfer with proof upload (preview thumbnail + bank details copy button) AND Payment Gateway option.
trip_booking_flow.invoice_confirmation: Printable/downloadable booking confirmation invoice with unique booking code, schedule details, shirt size, drink bonus, and status badge.

apparel_shop.customization: Color swatch pickers, size selector (XS-XXL), quantity adjuster, size guide modal, and Add to Cart / Buy Now actions.
apparel_shop.order_report: Admin apparel order summary report generator with size aggregation breakdown.

admin_dashboard.header_and_sidebar: Earthy dark sidebar (#1C1C1A) with active state in Forest Green (#2D4A3E). Clean header with search, notifications, admin profile, and quick actions.
admin_dashboard.booking_management: Table with filtering by status (Paid, Pending, Cancelled), quick edit modal for participant info, payment verification, and automatic 'Print Invoice' button.
admin_dashboard.reviews_management: Reviews tied directly to verified trip bookings to prevent fake reviews.
admin_dashboard.apparel_report_printing: Dedicated print-friendly view for apparel orders aggregated by item, size, and total quantity.

general_ui_ux_guidelines.data_testid: MANDATORY. Every interactive element (buttons, links, inputs, tabs, dropdowns, status badges, modals) MUST include a unique kebab-case `data-testid` attribute (e.g. data-testid='trip-booking-button', data-testid='admin-booking-row-1', data-testid='size-select-m').
general_ui_ux_guidelines.component_use: Use Shadcn/UI React components in src/components/ui for form controls, dialogs, dropdowns, tabs, and tables. Use custom Tailwind layouts for marketing and detail pages.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.notifications: Use Sonner (`import { toast } from 'sonner'`) for user feedback on booking creation, payment upload, cart additions, and admin actions.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.hover_and_transitions: Explicit hover states with color transitions (`transition-colors duration-200`). Always pair hover background changes with explicit text color definitions.
